annotations.title: Sky map card of a day

description: Makes a printable card of the sky on a day that matters - a birthday, the birth of a child, a wedding or any day - at a place: the link opens the sky map over that place (at the given hour, or 22:00) with a title, a line, the Moon's phase, sunrise and sunset, the planets, the signs and a QR code of the card, ready to print on A4, A3 or as an A6 greeting card. The answer also lists those facts, eclipses within 15 days, the meteor showers active that night and the NASA picture of the day of that date. Use it when someone wants a gift or keepsake of the night sky on a date.

lang.description: Language of the names in the answer: pl (default) or en

occasion.description: The card's page and default title (birthday by default)

place.description: A town or city, e.g. "Opole", "Kraków", "London"; the first match is used (Polish places come first)

qr.description: A QR code of the card in its corner (default true)

style.description: Dark blue (default), light, or black and white

subtitle.description: A line under it, e.g. names

time.description: HH:MM clock time at the place; leave out for the evening sky

tz.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Warsaw (with lat and lon)

name: sky_card
